title: How to Build a Mobile App Without Coding in 2026
summary: Build a mobile app without coding using AI — database, auth, and hosting automatically included. Full guide with step-by-step instructions.
body_markdown: Not directly from Blink. Blink builds a PWA, not a native binary. If you need an App Store listing, you can wrap the PWA in a native shell using a tool like Capacitor or Expo — but that requires a developer. For most business use cases, a PWA works without the App Store. Starbucks, Pinterest, and Uber use PWAs for mobile web.
